{{Quote|The Temple's armory stores these artifacts inside its Black Vault. I added the Tzuhakk broadsword after recovering it on Bpfassh.|Mace Windu, ''Book of Sith''|<ref name="BoS" />}}
The '''Tzuhakk broadsword''' was a [[Sith sword]] recovered by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] from<ref name="BoS" /> the [[Double planet/Legends|double planet]]<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> [[Bpfassh]]<ref name="BoS" /> by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' establishes that [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] recovered the Tzuhakk [[Sword/Legends|broadsword]]. Since Windu [[Death/Legends|died]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the broadsword must have been recovered by 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Subsequently, Master Windu wrote on a section of [[Sorzus Syn]]'s [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|chronicle]]&mdash;later assembled into the ''[[Book of Sith]]''&mdash;explaining that he placed the [[Sword/Legends|sword]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Black Vault]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] dedicated storage place of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] weaponry located on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="BoS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tzuhakk broadsword was mentioned in ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', a reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[2012]].<ref name="BoS" />
